lead.text: Six things the room orders most, and the ones we would put in front of a first-time guest.

items.name: Flat White

desc.text: Ristretto under a thin layer of steamed milk. Balanced, quietly strong.

items.imageNote: A milk coffee with latte art from the Google gallery — the closest match available, not a frame Savva labelled "Flat White". Confirm this is the drink served under that name, or send a photo of it.
items.imageAlt: Milk coffee with rosetta latte art in a stone-coloured cup

items.name: Spanish Latte

desc.text: Espresso, milk and condensed milk. Sweet, and meant to be.

items.imageAlt: The Savva monogram on a sage tile, standing in for a photograph

items.name: Matcha Latte

desc.text: Matcha whisked smooth, poured over cold milk. Grassy and calm.

items.imageAlt: Iced matcha layered green over berry in a clear branded cup

items.name: Cold Brew

desc.text: Steeped slowly overnight, served cold. Low acidity, long finish.

items.imageAlt: The Savva monogram on a sage tile, standing in for a photograph

items.name: Cheesecake

desc.text: The slice the reviews keep mentioning. Dense, cold, not too sweet.

items.imageAlt: The Savva monogram on a sage tile, standing in for a photograph

items.name: Madini Cookies

desc.text: Our own cookie, named for the city. Crisp at the edge, soft in the middle.

body.text: Savva is a specialty coffee house in Madinah. The room is quiet by design: soft light, a recently refreshed interior, and a terrace for the cooler hours. Doors open early and close at two.

items.alt: The room from the entrance: wooden chairs and round tables under string lights, the SAVVA sign over the counter at the back
The bar counter: stacks of sage SAVVA cups, the grinder and espresso machine, a plant on the marble top
A long beige sofa under two arched windows, white pedestal tables and round moulded chairs between potted trees
